QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_36

question.text: For NRI demat account opening, which document is mandatory in addition to PAN?

answer.text: Copy of passport/PIO Card/OCI Card and overseas address proof

explanation.text: The Logic: For non-residents and foreign nationals, a copy of the passport/PIO Card/OCI Card together with overseas address proof is mandatory in addition to PAN. The Trap: 'Only PAN card' is insufficient for NRIs; the overseas address proof and passport/PIO/OCI card are additionally required. Note: Merchant Navy NRIs must submit a Mariner's declaration or a certified copy of the Continuous Discharge Certificate (CDC) when applicable.
